title: 30" Single Wall Oven with Air Fry Mode
sub: Stainless steel, true convection, 5.0 cu. ft.
lead: A 30-inch KitchenAid wall oven with true convection, Air Fry Mode with its own dishwasher-safe basket, and a meat thermometer that turns the oven off when the roast is done. 5.0 cu. ft. inside, room for a whole turkey.

features.name: Air Fry Mode
features.line: Three heating elements and the convection fan move hot air all the way around the basket that comes with the oven, so fries and wings crisp and brown with less oil than deep frying. The basket goes in the dishwasher.

features.name: Even-Heat True Convection
features.line: A bow-tie shaped element and a fan carry heat through the whole oven, for baking, roasts and vegetables that cook evenly.

features.name: A thermometer that ends the cook
features.line: Set the temperature you want, from rare to well done. The oven watches the probe and turns itself off when the meat gets there.

features.name: SatinGlide roll-out rack
features.line: An extension rack on ball-bearing rollers, with an easy-grip handle, brings a heavy roasting pan out smoothly.

features.name: Even-Heat Preheat
features.line: Preheat runs 40°F past the set temperature, and warms the walls and racks, so the oven holds its heat when the door opens and the food goes in.

also: EasyConvect, which converts a regular recipe's temperature and time for convection
A 4,000-watt broil element for searing and browning
Self-cleaning cycle, with no chemical cleaners
Wi-Fi: run it from the KitchenAid app, or by voice with Alexa or Google Assistant
FIT System, made to fit standard, short or tall cutouts. KitchenAid's limited FIT guarantee excludes new cabinet installations and runs on dates KitchenAid sets, so ask us for the current terms.
Also made in white, PrintShield stainless and black stainless
